stories.new_fact: President Trump established a committee of inquiry on October 9 to investigate Fed Governor Lisa Cook and set a November 5 White House hearing.
stories.new_takeaway: The operational issue is whether confidence in independent rate-setting becomes a borrowing-cost factor for markets, banks and borrowers.
stories.why_now: AP reported the committee and hearing memo on October 9, inside the 24-hour window for this episode.
stories.previous_coverage: The previous seven scripts did not cover the Cook committee; recent national segments covered visas, FCC/media, jobs and election operations.
stories.uncertainty: Cook's appearance, the legal basis for removal and the market response remain unresolved.
stories.watch: Whether the White House publishes new evidence or legal reasoning before Cook's November 5 hearing.

stories.new_fact: Axios Columbus listed the Italian Festival, Groveport Apple Butter Day, the Columbus Symphony and Ohio State-Maryland as key weekend events, while the local forecast shows rain risk rising Sunday.
stories.new_takeaway: The useful local consequence is traffic, parking and timing: use Saturday's dry window before rain slows Sunday travel.
stories.why_now: The events take place October 10 and October 11, and the Axios weekend guide was published October 9.
stories.previous_coverage: Recent Columbus segments covered housing, crisis response, utilities, voting and weather; this specific weekend logistics item was not covered.
stories.uncertainty: Event attendance and rain timing can shift; the story is a planning note, not a civic policy development.
stories.watch: Whether Sunday rain from Isaias causes travel delays or event changes in Central Ohio.

stories.new_fact: MBA said the Mortgage Credit Availability Index fell 0.2 percent to 107.1 in September, with conventional documentation tightening and fewer cash-out refinance and investor-purchase offerings.
stories.new_takeaway: The operational consequence is edge tightening on product matrices, documentation timing and borrower promises while rates already pressure qualification.
stories.why_now: MBA published the September MCAI release on October 8, within 48 hours of the October 10 episode.
stories.previous_coverage: The prior seven episodes covered Fannie guide updates, UAD exceptions, Freddie OAuth, score-model plumbing and rate shocks; MCAI product tightening was not covered.
stories.uncertainty: The release does not show loan-level fallout, denial rates or whether the tightening persists into October.
stories.watch: Whether Tuesday's existing-home sales report shows rates and tighter credit cutting demand.

stories.new_fact: FinTech Futures reported DNB plans to cut about 400 full-time positions, mainly in technology and services, as AI agents and digital automation replace manual tasks.
stories.new_takeaway: The banking-AI takeaway moves from adoption claims to staffing and control design, but the public metric is headcount rather than quality or compliance results.
stories.why_now: This is a previously uncovered specialist update from October 7, selected on a quiet Saturday because it changes an operating decision.
stories.previous_coverage: Recent bank-AI segments covered BNP Paribas, Plaid, Incognia, Barclays, Kyndryl, Upstart and Feedzai; DNB was not covered.
stories.uncertainty: DNB did not disclose error rates, cycle-time baselines, customer outcomes or regulator acceptance of AI-assisted KYC and data workflows.
stories.watch: Whether DNB discloses workflow-specific quality, cycle-time, customer or regulator evidence as the Q4 restructuring is booked.
stories.date_exception: Specialist bank-AI beat used one previously uncovered update from the last seven days because it has direct staffing and control-design consequences.
stories.ledger_row_changed: DNB / lanes 7 and 8 / added announced restructuring row tied to AI agents in customer data management, KYC, technology development and software coding.

stories.new_fact: OpenAI said it fired three safety researchers for a breach of trust, while the researchers warned that unclear rules and fear were chilling AI safety work.
stories.new_takeaway: The frontier issue is not a benchmark; it is whether lab safety processes and external assessment access are credible enough for regulated buyers.
stories.why_now: AP reported the firings and public dispute on October 9, and published a related self-policing story early October 10.
stories.previous_coverage: Recent frontier segments covered Anthropic cyber access, GPT-6 UI, agent probing and federal task-force policy; this specific internal safety-process dispute was not covered.
stories.uncertainty: The public record does not resolve whether policy violations or retaliation concerns drove the firings.
stories.watch: Whether OpenAI gives external assessors enough access to answer the safety-process dispute.
stories.frontier_bar: Safety and policy item involving frontier-lab internal safety process, third-party oversight and self-policing credibility.

stories.new_fact: AP reported the S&P 500 rose 0.6 percent, the Dow gained 423 points, Brent settled at $104.72 and the 10-year Treasury yield rose to 5.24 percent.
stories.new_takeaway: Equities can finish higher while borrowers, lenders and local finance teams still face expensive long money.
stories.why_now: The AP market wrap covers the October 9 close.
stories.previous_coverage: Markets have been compactly covered in recent episodes; this is included as current context for rates, oil and earnings week.
stories.uncertainty: Next week's inflation, retail sales and bank earnings data will test whether the pressure is being absorbed or spreading.
stories.watch: Whether inflation data, retail sales and bank earnings confirm consumer and financing stress.

stories.new_fact: Columbus forecast at cutoff showed sun through high clouds Saturday near 73 and some Sunday rain from Tropical Rainstorm Isaias.
stories.new_takeaway: The Saturday outdoor window is better than Sunday, when slower travel and reduced visibility are possible.
stories.why_now: The forecast applies to October 10 and October 11 in Columbus.
stories.previous_coverage: Routine weather is updated daily and kept compact.
stories.uncertainty: Rain timing and intensity may change as Isaias moves inland.
stories.watch: Whether Sunday rain slows Central Ohio travel.
